source_metadata.title: Tracing the Heart: An Evidence-Linked Pipeline for Heart-Failure Feature Engineering

extraction_limitations: Extraction is grounded in the uploaded 29-page preprint and its appendix; no external verification was performed.
No funding-disclosure, conflict-of-interest, or data-availability statement was located in the paper text, so no atoms of those kinds were created.
Background epidemiology and claims attributed to cited prior studies were not atomized as findings of this primary source.
Illustrative JSON examples and prompt excerpts were represented through higher-level method atoms rather than atomizing every field/token in the examples.
The complete point-based scoring rubric was represented at the feature-category level (one method atom per category) rather than one atom per individual point-rule line.
All extracted atoms are marked needs_review because extraction was model-assisted and was not independently human-verified.
